l-m-m1-b04-25.goal: Yi nazari ko ikirarin cewa jimillar kusurwoyi masu kaifi biyu koyaushe kusurwa mai faɗi ce gaskiya ne a kowane hali, sannan nemo ka bayyana misalin da bai dace ba (misali na ƙaryatawa).

l-m-m1-b04-25.s.s1.r.a: 125° kusurwa ce mai faɗi. Wannan misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.

l-m-m1-b04-25.s.s1.r.c: 150° kusurwa ce mai faɗi. Wannan misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.
l-m-m1-b04-25.s.s1.explain: 20°+30°=50° kusurwa mai kaifi ce. Idan akwai yanayin da jimillar ba kusurwa mai faɗi ba ce, ikirarin ba daidai ba ne.
l-m-m1-b04-25.s.s2.model.0: 20°+30°=50° ne, kuma 50° ba kusurwa mai faɗi ba ce, saboda haka ikirarin ba daidai ba ne.
l-m-m1-b04-25.s.s2.model.1: Idan kusurwoyin biyu masu kaifi ƙanana ne, jimillarsu ma za ta iya zama ƙasa da 90°. Saboda haka 20° da 30° misali ne na ƙaryatawa.

l-m-m1-b0s4-02.title: Idan jimlar haɗin gwiwar ta tabbata, shin ma'anar a cikin quadrant na 1st?
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.goal: A bincika ko da'awar cewa duk abin da jimlar sa ta tabbata yana cikin quadrant na 1 koyaushe gaskiya ne, sannan ku nemo kuma ku bayyana lamarin inda ya gaza (misali).
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.material: Da'awar: Don maki (a, b), idan a +b yana da inganci, ma'anar koyaushe tana cikin quadrant 1st. Nemo batu da ke nuna wannan da'awar ba daidai ba ce. (Quadrant na 1 shine inda duka x-coordinate da y-coordinate suke tabbatacce.)
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi batun da ya saba wa da'awar (misali).
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.s.s1.r.a: a+b=7 kuma yana cikin quadrant 1st. Misali ne wanda ya dace da da'awar.
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.s.s1.r.b: a+b=-3 mara kyau ne, don haka bai dace da yanayin da'awar ba.
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.s.s1.r.d: a+b=2 kuma yana cikin quadrant 1st. Misali ne wanda ya dace da da'awar.
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.s.s1.explain: Don (3, -1), a+b=2 tabbatacce ne, amma y-coordinate mara kyau ne, don haka yana cikin quadrant na 4. Ko da jimlar tana da inganci, ƙila ba za ta kasance cikin quadrant na 1st ba.
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.s.s2.model.0: Don (3, -1), 3+(-1) = 2 tabbatacce ne, amma y-coordinate mara kyau ne, don haka yana cikin quadrant na 4. Shi ya sa ya zama abin misali.
l-m-m1-b0s4-02.s.s2.model.1: Ko da jimlar ta kasance tabbatacce, haɗin kai ɗaya na iya zama mara kyau, don haka (3, -1) yana cikin quadrant na 4 kuma da'awar ba daidai ba ne.

l-m-m1-b01-10.goal: Ka yanke shawarar abin da ake buƙata da gaske don gano ko furci magana ce ta layi, kuma ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ka zaɓi shi.

l-m-m1-b01-10.s.s1.o.d: Ko adadin lokutan da aka ninka mabambanta (digiri) shine 1

l-m-m1-b02-08.topic: Mafi Girman Mai Raba Gama-gari da Ƙaramin Ninkin Gama-gari
l-m-m1-b02-08.goal: Don gane matsalar da take buƙatar mafi girman mai raba gama-gari, yanke shawarar wane ma’auni (bayani) ake buƙata ƙwarai, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-m1-b02-08.material: Ana son yanke igiyoyin tsawon 48 cm da 72 cm zuwa gutsuttsura masu tsayi iri ɗaya ba tare da saura ba, domin a samu gutsuttsura mafi tsawo. Ka yi tunanin ma’aunin da zai nuna ko ana buƙatar mafi girman mai raba gama-gari ko ƙaramin ninkin gama-gari.
l-m-m1-b02-08.s.s1.prompt: Me ne yake yanke abin da za a nema?
l-m-m1-b02-08.s.s1.o.a: Wanne daga cikin lambobin biyu ya fi girma
l-m-m1-b02-08.s.s1.r.a: Girman lambobin kaɗai ba ya yanke abin da za a nema.
l-m-m1-b02-08.s.s1.o.b: Ko lambobin biyu suna da ninki biyu
l-m-m1-b02-08.s.s1.r.b: Kasancewar lambobin suna da ninki biyu ba ma’aunin bambance waɗannan dabaru biyu ba ne.
l-m-m1-b02-08.s.s1.o.c: Ko yanayi ne na raba abubuwa zuwa daidai girma
l-m-m1-b02-08.s.s1.o.d: Ko lambobin biyu ba su da wani mai raba gama-gari sai 1

l-m-m1-b05-02.material: Ana son tara lambobi cikakku biyu masu alamomi mabambanta, kamar −7 da +4. Ka yi tunanin wane bayani ake buƙata da gaske domin sanin ko jimillar tabbatacciya ce ko mara kyau.
l-m-m1-b05-02.s.s1.o.a: Alamar lambar da aka rubuta da farko
l-m-m1-b05-02.s.s1.r.a: Ko da lambar farko mara kyau ce, kamar (−4)+(+7), jimillar na iya zama tabbatacciya.
l-m-m1-b05-02.s.s1.r.b: Lambar ɗaya ba ta da alaƙa da alamar jimillar.
l-m-m1-b05-02.s.s1.r.c: Ninkin lambobi biyu masu alamomi mabambanta koyaushe mara kyau ne, don haka ba ya nuna alamar jimillar.
l-m-m1-b05-02.s.s1.o.d: Alamar lambar da cikakkiyar ƙimarta ta fi girma
l-m-m1-b05-02.s.s1.explain: Jimillar lambobi biyu masu alamomi mabambanta tana ɗaukar alamar wadda cikakkiyar ƙimarta ta fi girma. Ga −7 da +4, 7 ya fi girma, don haka jimillar mara kyau ce.
l-m-m1-b05-02.s.s2.model.0: Lambar da cikakkiyar ƙimarta ta fi girma ce ke yanke alamar jimillar, saboda haka dole ne a kwatanta cikakkiyar ƙimomin lambobin biyu.
l-m-m1-b05-02.s.s2.model.1: Lambar da aka rubuta da farko ko alamar ninkin ba sa nuna alamar jimillar; saboda haka ana buƙatar sanin wadda cikakkiyar ƙimarta ta fi girma.

l-m-m1-b05-10.title: Ma’aunin Gano Daidaiton Lissafi da Ba Shi da Mafita
l-m-m1-b05-10.topic: Mafitar Daidaiton Lissafi Mai Layin Ɗaya
l-m-m1-b05-10.goal: Bayyana wane ma’auni (bayani) ake buƙata don gano lokacin da ax=b ba shi da mafita, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-m1-b05-10.material: A cikin daidaiton lissafi ax=b mai canjin x, ana son gano yanayin da babu x da zai cika daidaiton. Wane ma’auni game da a da b ya kamata a duba?
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s1.r.a: Idan a=0 kuma b=0, to 0·x=0, saboda haka kowace x mafita ce.
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s1.r.c: Idan b=0, to x=0 mafita ce.
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s1.r.d: Ko da a mara kyau ne, x=b/a mafita ce.
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s1.explain: Idan a=0, to 0·x=b. Idan b≠0, babu x da zai yi aiki, saboda haka babu mafita.
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s2.model.0: Idan a=0, gefen hagu koyaushe 0 ne, saboda haka babu mafita ne kawai idan b ba 0 ba ne.
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s2.model.1: Idan a=0 kuma b=0, kowace x mafita ce; saboda haka dole ne a duba cewa b≠0 ne ma.

l-m-m1-b05-34.title: Ganin rarraba yayin kiyaye ƙimar asali
l-m-m1-b05-34.goal: Don gano yadda ake ganin rarrabawa yayin adana bayanan asali, yanke shawarar wane ma'auni (bayani) da gaske ake buƙata kuma bayyana dalilin da yasa kuka zaɓi shi.
l-m-m1-b05-34.material: Kuna son ganin rikodin gudu na ɗalibai 20 a kallo. Kuna so ku ga siffar rarraba kuma ku kiyaye ainihin rikodin kowane ɗalibi. Yanke shawarar wacce hanyar tsara bayanan ta dace.
l-m-m1-b05-34.s.s1.prompt: Wace hanya ce ta tsara ta dace?
l-m-m1-b05-34.s.s1.r.b: Ana nuna shi tare da sanduna, don haka ainihin bayanan sun ɓace.
l-m-m1-b05-34.s.s1.r.c: Yana da maki masu haɗa layi, don haka ainihin bayanan bace.
l-m-m1-b05-34.s.s1.r.d: Haɗa cikin azuzuwan yana sa ainihin bayanan su ɓace.
l-m-m1-b05-34.s.s1.explain: Makirci mai tushe da ganye yana rubuta kowane ƙima kamar yadda yake kuma yana nuna siffar rarraba.
l-m-m1-b05-34.s.s2.model.0: A cikin makircin tushe-da-ganye, ganye sune ƙimar kowane ma'aunin bayanai, don haka ainihin bayanan suna tsayawa kuma sifar ta nuna ma.
l-m-m1-b05-34.s.s2.model.1: Teburin rarraba mitar ko jadawali bayanan zuwa ajujuwa, don haka ba za ku iya sanin ƙimar asali ba.

l-m-m1-b0s4-03.title: Me kuke buƙatar sanin jimlar kusurwoyi na ciki?
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.goal: Don nemo jimlar kusurwoyin ciki na polygon convex, yanke shawarar wane ma'auni (bayani) da gaske ake buƙata kuma bayyana dalilin da yasa kuka zaɓi shi.
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.material: Kuna son nemo jimlar kusurwoyin ciki na polygon convex. Kowane polygon yana da siffa da girma dabam. Yi tunani game da abin da bayanin ke gyara jimlar.
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani ake buƙata da gaske don sanin jimlar kusurwoyin ciki?
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.s.s1.r.a: Ko da gefe yana da tsawo, jimlar kusurwoyin ciki ba ya canzawa. Ba a buƙatar tsayin gefen.
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.s.s1.r.b: Ko da kewaye ɗaya ne, jimlar ta bambanta idan adadin bangarorin ya bambanta.
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.s.s1.r.c: Babban kwana ɗaya kaɗai ba zai iya gaya muku jimillar sauran kusurwoyi ba.
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.s.s1.explain: Jimlar kusurwoyin ciki shine (yawan bangarorin-2) × 180 °, don haka an daidaita shi da zarar kun san adadin bangarorin. Ba a buƙatar tsayin gefen da kewaye.
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.s.s2.model.0: Idan kun san adadin bangarorin, zaku iya raba polygon zuwa triangles kuma ku sami jimlar, don haka ana buƙatar adadin bangarorin da gaske.
l-m-m1-b0s4-03.s.s2.model.1: Tare da adadin bangarorin guda ɗaya, jimlar daidai take ko da sifofin sun bambanta, don haka tsayi da kewaye ba a buƙatar kuma adadin bangarorin kadai ya isa.

l-m-m1-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: An ɗauka kamar rabin 60° ne, amma ka’idar ita ce 360°÷yawan gefuna.

l-m-m1-b03-11.material: Zana layuka ta yadda babu biyu masu layi ɗaya kuma babu layuka uku da za su haɗu a maki guda. Da layuka 2 akwai haɗuwa 1; da layuka 3 akwai 3; da layuka 4 akwai 6. Nemo ka’idar.

l-m-m1-b03-11.s.s1.r.a: Ka ci gaba da ƙara adadin da ya ƙaru da 2.

l-m-m1-b03-11.s.s1.r.d: Ka ɗauki ƙarin a matsayin 6. A zahiri yana ƙaruwa da 4.
l-m-m1-b03-11.s.s1.explain: Yawan haɗuwa 1, 3, 6 yana ƙaruwa da 2, sannan 3. Gaba zai ƙaru da 4, saboda haka 6+4=10.
l-m-m1-b03-11.s.s2.model.0: Ƙarin yana ƙaruwa da 1: 2, 3; saboda haka na gaba 4 ne, kuma haɗuwa 6+4=10 ne.
l-m-m1-b03-11.s.s2.model.1: Kowane sabon layi yana haɗuwa da kowane layin da ya gabata sau ɗaya, don haka layi na 5 yana ƙara haɗuwa 4, ya zama 10.

l-m-m1-b03-12.goal: Duba wasu misalan yawan masu raba ƙimomin ƙarfin 2, bayyana tsarin da ka gani, sannan ka gwada shi da sabon misali.
l-m-m1-b03-12.material: Masu raba 2 su ne 1 da 2, don haka masu raba 2 ne. Masu raba 4 su ne 1, 2, 4, don haka masu raba 3 ne. Masu raba 8 su ne 1, 2, 4, 8, don haka masu raba 4 ne. Nemo tsarin yawan masu raba yayin da ƙarfin 2 ke ƙaruwa.
l-m-m1-b03-12.s.s1.prompt: Ta amfani da tsarin, masu raba nawa ne 2⁷=128 yake da su?

l-m-m1-b03-12.s.s1.r.c: 64 mai raba guda ɗaya ne na 128, ba yawan masu rabansa ba.
l-m-m1-b03-12.s.s1.explain: 2¹ yana da masu raba 2, 2² yana da 3, 2³ yana da 4; kowanne ya fi exponent da 1. Saboda haka 2⁷ yana da masu raba 7+1=8.
l-m-m1-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Idan exponent 1, 2, 3 ne, yawan masu raba 2, 3, 4 ne, wato 1 fiye da exponent. Don haka 2⁷ yana da masu raba 8.

l-m-m1-b04-11.title: Xeerka lagu helo xalka x−a=b
l-m-m1-b04-11.goal: Ka soo saar xeerka xalalka da’awa x−a=b tusaalooyin, kadib xeerka ku tijaabi xaalad cusub.
l-m-m1-b04-11.material: Xalka x−3=5 waa 8; x−7=2 waa 9; x−1=6 waa 7. Ka hel xiriirka xalka iyo labada tiro.
l-m-m1-b04-11.s.s1.prompt: Haddii isla xeerku shaqeeyo, waa maxay xalka x−12=4?
l-m-m1-b04-11.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad samaysay 12−4. Tusaalooyinka xalku waa wadarta labada tiro.
l-m-m1-b04-11.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad samaysay 4−12. Tusaalooyinka xalku waa wadarta labada tiro.
l-m-m1-b04-11.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad isku dhufatay labada tiro, laakiin tusaalooyinka xalku ma aha isku-dhufasho.
l-m-m1-b04-11.s.s1.explain: Xalka x−a=b waa a+b. Ku dar a labada dhinac, x baa hadhaya; x−12=4 waxay siinaysaa x=16.
l-m-m1-b04-11.s.s2.model.0: Saddexda tusaale, tirada la jaray iyo jawaabta marka la isku daro waxay noqotaa xalka; 12+4=16.
l-m-m1-b04-11.s.s2.model.1: 12 ayaa x laga jaray oo 4 hadhay, sidaas x=4+12=16. Tusaalooyinkuna isla xeerka ayay raacaan.

l-m-m1-b0s4-05.goal: Ka soo saar xeerka dhererka qaansada marka xagasha dhexe kordho, kadib ku tijaabi xaalad cusub.
l-m-m1-b0s4-05.material: Goobo radius 6cm leh, xaglo dhexe 30°,60°,90°,120° waxay leeyihiin qaansooyin π,2π,3π,4π cm. Hel xeerka isbeddelka.
l-m-m1-b0s4-05.s.s1.prompt: Xeerka marka la adeegsado, dhererka qaansadu imisa cm ayuu yahay marka xagasha dhexe 150°?
l-m-m1-b0s4-05.s.s1.r.a: Taasi waa qiimaha 120°. 150° wuxuu u baahan yahay tallaabo kale oo 30°.
l-m-m1-b0s4-05.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad xagasha dhexe sida ay tahay ku dhufatay. Xeerku waa π ayaa kordha 30° kasta.
l-m-m1-b0s4-05.s.s1.r.c: Taasi waa 180°. Xeerka wuxuu kordhaa π mar kasta oo 30° lagu daro; hal tallaabo ayaad dhaaftay.
l-m-m1-b0s4-05.s.s1.explain: Xagasha dhexe 30° kasta oo kordha, qaansadu π bay kordhaa. 150° waa shan jeer 30°, sidaas dhererku 5π cm. (5)
l-m-m1-b0s4-05.s.s2.model.0: Inta jeer ee xagasha 30° ku jirto waa inta jeer ee π ku jirto dhererka. 150° waa 5×30°, sidaas 5π.
l-m-m1-b0s4-05.s.s2.model.1: Marka xagasha dhexe labanlaabanto ama saddexlaabanto, qaansadu sidoo kale; 150° waxay noqotaa 5π cm. (2 2 3 3)

l-m-m1-b04-28.title: Ƙiyasta kusurwar ciki guda ta polygon na yau da kullum
l-m-m1-b04-28.topic: Kusurwoyin Ciki da na Waje na Siffofi Masu Gefuna Da Dama
l-m-m1-b04-28.goal: Yi ƙiyasin girman kusurwar ciki guda ta icosagon na yau da kullum don zaɓar girma ko zangon da ya dace, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-m-m1-b04-28.material: Yayin da yawan gefuna na polygon na yau da kullum ke ƙaruwa, siffar tana ƙara kama da da’ira. Yi ƙiyasin kusan girman kusurwar ciki guda ta icosagon. (Jimillar kusurwoyin waje 20 ita ce 360°.)
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s1.prompt: Kusan digiri nawa ne kusurwar ciki guda?
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s1.r.a: Wannan shi ne girman kusurwar waje guda. Don samun kusurwar ciki, cire kusurwar waje daga 180°.
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ita ce kusurwar ciki guda ta murabba’i. Tare da gefuna 20, kusurwar ta fi haka girma sosai.
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s1.r.d: 360° ita ce jimillar kusurwoyin waje. Kusurwar ciki guda ta gaza 180°.
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s1.explain: Kusurwar waje guda ita ce 360°÷20=18°, kuma kusurwar ciki ita ce 180°−18°=162°. Saboda haka kusan 160° ce.
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s2.model.0: Kusurwar waje kusan 360÷20=18° ce, don haka kusurwar ciki 180−18=162° ce, wato kusan 160°.
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s2.model.1: Tare da gefuna 20, siffar kusan da’ira ce, saboda haka kusurwar ciki guda tana kusa da 180°. Kusurwar kusan 160° ce, wato digiri 18° ƙasa da 180°.

l-m-m1-b05-31.title: Samaynta alwatika isle’eg: isbarbar dhig laba hab
l-m-m1-b05-31.goal: Kwatali hababka ama sheegashooyinka samaynta alwatika isle’eg ee AB dhinac ka ah, dooro habboon oo sababta sharax.
l-m-m1-b05-31.material: Samee alwatika isle’eg oo AB dhinac ah. M: A iyo B ka sawir qaanso radius AB, barta ay ku kulmaan C. N: C ku hel qaansooyin isku radius ah oo ka dheer AB, laga bilaabo A iyo B.
l-m-m1-b05-31.s.s1.r.b: Radius ya fi AB tsayi, don haka AC da BC sun fi AB tsayi.
l-m-m1-b05-31.s.s1.r.c: N yana yin triangle isosceles inda kawai AC=BC.
l-m-m1-b05-31.s.s1.o.d: Haka kuma baya yin madaidaicin alwatika
l-m-m1-b05-31.s.s1.r.d: A cikin M, dukkan bangarorin uku daidai suke da AB.
l-m-m1-b05-31.s.s1.explain: A cikin M, AC da BC daidai suke da radius AB, don haka dukkan bangarorin uku daidai suke. N yana ba da triangle isosceles tare da AC=BC>AB.
l-m-m1-b05-31.s.s2.model.0: A cikin M, AC da BC daidai suke da radius AB, don haka alwatika ce mai daidaitacce tare da daidaikun bangarori uku.
l-m-m1-b05-31.s.s2.model.1: A cikin N, AC da BC sun fi AB tsayi, don haka bangarorin uku ba su daidaita kuma ba alwatika ba ne.

l-m-m1-b0s4-13.material: Radius 10cm, xagal dhexe 72°, dherer qaanso 4πcm. Habka 1:100π×72/360=20π. Habka 2:½×radius×qaanso=½×10×4π=20π. Labaduba isku mid.

l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s1.r.c: Habka 1 sidoo kale waa sax, qaybta goobo ayay ka tahay.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s1.o.d: Qiimuhu isku mid, sidaas looma baahna xagasha dhexe.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s1.r.d: Habka 2 sidoo kale wuxuu u baahan yahay xagasha dhexe si loo helo qaansada.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s1.explain: Labada hab sax bay yihiin, isku natiijo. Haddii xagal dhexe oo keliya la yaqaan, Habka 1 fudud; haddii qaanso la hayo, Habka 2.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s2.model.0: Labadooduba 20π bay bixiyaan. Haddii qaansadu hore loo yaqaan, Habka 2 oo isku dhufasho keliya ah ayaa habboon.
l-m-m1-b0s4-13.s.s2.model.1: Habka 1 wuxuu qaataa 72/360 goobada; Habka 2 wuxuu u shaqeeyaa sida saddex-xagal, dhaqso marka qaansadu la hayo.

l-m-m1-b03-36.s.s1.r.d: Ya dace da yanayin, amma yana yiwuwa tare da mutane kaɗan.
l-m-m1-b03-36.s.s1.explain: Tare da mutane 6, (12000+18000)÷6 = 5000 ya ci nasara, wanda ya dace da yanayin, kuma tare da mutane kaɗan ya wuce 5000 nasara.
l-m-m1-b03-36.s.s2.model.0: Tare da mutane 6, jimlar 30000 da aka raba ta 6 shine 5000 ya ci kowanne, don haka wannan shine mafi ƙarancin mutane waɗanda suka cika yanayin.

l-m-m1-b03-38.title: Haɗa Tafiya da Gudu don Zuwa akan Lokaci
l-m-m1-b03-38.goal: Yi la'akari da duk yanayin rikice-rikice na zabar nisan tafiya da nisa don gudu, zaɓi mafi kyawun sulhu, kuma bayyana dalilin.
l-m-m1-b03-38.material: Kuna son tafiya kilomita 6 cikin awa 1. Gudun tafiya yana da kilomita 4 a cikin sa'a guda kuma gudun yana da kilomita 8 a kowace sa'a, kuma nisan tafiya da nisan gudu ya kai kilomita 6. Kuna so ku gudu, wanda yake da gajiya, kadan kamar yadda zai yiwu.
l-m-m1-b03-38.s.s1.r.b: Yana tsayawa a cikin awa 1, amma yana da mafi yawan gudu.
l-m-m1-b03-38.s.s1.r.c: Yana tsayawa cikin sa'a 1, amma nisan tafiya zai iya zama tsayi.
l-m-m1-b03-38.s.s1.r.d: Ƙara awa 3/4 na tafiya da 3/8 na gudu yana yin fiye da awa 1.
l-m-m1-b03-38.s.s1.explain: Tare da nisan tafiya na kilomita 2 da nisan gudu na kilomita 4, shine 0.5+0.5=1 hour. Idan nisan tafiya ya fi tsayi, ya wuce awa 1.
l-m-m1-b03-38.s.s2.model.0: Don 2 km, 2÷4+4÷8=1 hour, don haka ya dace da yanayin lokaci kuma yana da mafi guntu tazarar gudu.
l-m-m1-b03-38.s.s2.model.1: Tafiya kilomita 3 yana ɗaukar sa'o'i 1.125, wanda ya fi awa 1, don haka kilomita 2 shine iyaka don tafiya.

l-m-m1-b03-39.goal: Yi la'akari da duk yanayin rikice-rikice a cikin zabar yawan adadin ruwan 'ya'yan itace da ruwa, zaɓi mafi kyawun sulhu, kuma bayyana dalilin.
l-m-m1-b03-39.material: Mix ruwan 'ya'yan itace mai da hankali da ruwa a cikin rabo 1: 3. Dole ne kofi ɗaya ya zama 300 ml ko ƙasa da haka, kuma don dandano dole ne a yi amfani da aƙalla 40 ml na mai da hankali. Kuna so ku yi amfani da ɗan hankali sosai gwargwadon yiwuwa.

l-m-m1-b03-39.s.s1.r.c: Ya dace da sharuɗɗan, amma zaka iya amfani da ƙasa da hankali.
l-m-m1-b03-39.s.s1.r.d: Jimlar ita ce 320 ml, wanda ya wuce 300 ml.
l-m-m1-b03-39.s.s1.explain: Tare da maida hankali 40 ml, ruwan shine 120 ml kuma jimlar shine 160 ml. Ya dace da sharuɗɗan biyu tare da mafi ƙarancin maida hankali.
l-m-m1-b03-39.s.s2.model.0: 40 ml maida hankali da 120 ml ruwa jimlar 160 ml, don haka sun hadu da duka girman kofin da yanayin dandano.
l-m-m1-b03-39.s.s2.model.1: Dole ne mai da hankali ya zama aƙalla 40 ml, don haka mafi ƙarancin adadin da ya dace da sharuɗɗan shine 40 ml.

l-m-m1-b04-32.title: Yanke kek zuwa guntuttsura masu daidai
l-m-m1-b04-32.goal: Raba kek zagaye zuwa guntuttsura masu siffar ɓangaren da’ira yana buƙatar auna sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa wa juna, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-m1-b04-32.material: Ana raba kek zagaye gaba ɗaya zuwa guntuttsura masu siffar ɓangaren da’ira, masu kusurwar tsakiya iri ɗaya. Kusurwar tsakiya ta yanki guda dole ta zama cikakkiyar lambar digiri kuma ta kai aƙalla 40°, kuma ana son yawan guntuttsura mafi yawa.
l-m-m1-b04-32.s.s1.prompt: Wane yawan guntuttsura ne ya fi dacewa da sharuɗɗan ukun?
l-m-m1-b04-32.s.s1.r.a: 360°÷7 ba cikakkiyar lambar digiri ba ce, saboda haka ba za a iya raba kek ɗin daidai ba.
l-m-m1-b04-32.s.s1.r.b: Ya cika sharuɗɗan, amma ana iya raba shi zuwa guntuttsura 9 (kusurwar 40°).
l-m-m1-b04-32.s.s1.r.d: Kusurwar tsakiya 36° ce, saboda haka ba ta kai aƙalla 40° ba.
l-m-m1-b04-32.s.s1.explain: Kusurwar tsakiya ita ce 360°÷yawan guntuttsura. Idan guntuttsura 9 ne, kusurwar 40° ce kuma sharadin ya cika; amma guntuttsura 10 yana ba 36°, don haka bai dace ba.
l-m-m1-b04-32.s.s2.model.0: Da guntuttsura 9, kusurwar tsakiya 360÷9=40° ce, wadda ta kai aƙalla 40°, saboda haka ta cika sharuɗɗan kuma tana ba da guntuttsura mafi yawa.
l-m-m1-b04-32.s.s2.model.1: Guntuttsura 10 yana ba da kusurwa 36°, don haka bai dace ba; guntuttsura 8 kuwa yana ba da 45° amma guntuttsurarsa kaɗan ce. Saboda haka amsar ita ce guntuttsura 9.

l-m-m1-b04-40.title: Yanke Shawarar Yawan Masu Amsa Bincike
l-m-m1-b04-40.goal: Yanke shawarar yawan mutanen da za su amsa bincike yana buƙatar auna sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa wa juna, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-m-m1-b04-40.material: Kowace takardar tambayoyi tana cin 150 won, kuma kasafin kuɗi bai wuce 6,000 won ba. Ana shirya sakamakon a matsayin yawan dangantaka, kuma dole ne kowane yawan dangantaka ya fito daidai idan aka zagaye zuwa wurare goma biyu. A yi bincike ga mutane da yawa gwargwadon iko.
l-m-m1-b04-40.s.s1.prompt: Wane yawan mutane ne ya fi dacewa da sharuɗɗan ukun?
l-m-m1-b04-40.s.s1.r.a: Ya cika sharuɗɗan, amma ana iya kaiwa mutane 25.
l-m-m1-b04-40.s.s1.r.c: Yawan dangantaka na mutum 1 shi ne 0.025, wanda yake kaiwa wuri na goma na uku.
l-m-m1-b04-40.s.s1.r.d: Kuɗin ya zama 7,500 won, wanda ya wuce kasafin 6,000 won.
l-m-m1-b04-40.s.s1.explain: Domin yawan dangantaka su kasance daidai zuwa wurare goma biyu, dole ne yawan mutane ya zama mai raba 100. Mafi girman irin wannan adadi da bai wuce takardu 40 ba shi ne 25.
l-m-m1-b04-40.s.s2.model.0: Binciken mutane 25 yana cin 3,750 won, wanda bai wuce kasafi ba; yawan dangantakar mutum 1 kuma 0.04 ne, mai daidaito zuwa wuri na goma na biyu. Idan mutane 40 ne, ƙimar ta zama 0.025.
l-m-m1-b04-40.s.s2.model.1: Daga cikin masu raba 100 waɗanda ba su wuce 40 ba, mafi girma shi ne 25; saboda haka ana iya bincika mutane 25.

l-m-m1-b05-32.title: Zaɓin gefen uku na shingen triangular
l-m-m1-b05-32.goal: A zabar tsawon gefen uku na shinge mai triangular, auna duk yanayin da ke rikici da juna, zaɓi mafi dacewa sulhu, kuma bayyana dalilin.
l-m-m1-b05-32.material: Kuna yin shinge mai siffar triangle tare da bangarori biyu na 7m da 4m. Bangaren na uku shine cikakken adadin m, dole ne ya samar da alwatika, jimlar kewaye dole ne ya zama 18m ko ƙasa da haka, kuma yakamata ya kasance gwargwadon iko.
l-m-m1-b05-32.s.s1.prompt: Wane bangare na uku ne ya fi dacewa da dukkan sharudda uku?
l-m-m1-b05-32.s.s1.r.a: 7=4+3, don haka sassan layi suna layi madaidaiciya kuma ba za a iya yin triangle ba.
l-m-m1-b05-32.s.s1.r.c: Yana yin triangle, amma kewaye shine 21m, wanda ya wuce 18m.
l-m-m1-b05-32.s.s1.r.d: 7+4=11, don haka sassan layi suna layi madaidaiciya kuma ba za a iya yin triangle ba.
l-m-m1-b05-32.s.s1.explain: A cikin triangle, gefen mafi tsayi dole ne ya zama ƙasa da jimlar sauran bangarorin biyu. Idan kewaye ya kasance 18m ko ƙasa da haka, gefen uku shine 7m ko ƙasa da haka, kuma mafi tsayin waɗannan shine 7m.
l-m-m1-b05-32.s.s2.model.0: Ga bangarorin uku na 7, 4, da 7, gefen mafi tsayi bai kai adadin sauran biyun ba, don haka suna yin triangle, kuma kewayen shine 18m.
l-m-m1-b05-32.s.s2.model.1: Ba a yarda 10m ba saboda kewayen zai zama 21m, kuma 3m da 11m a layi a madaidaiciyar layi, don haka 7m ya dace.

l-m-m1-b05-40.title: Zaɓin maki biyar waɗanda suka dace da sharuɗɗan
l-m-m1-b05-40.goal: Don maki na ɗalibai biyar waɗanda suka dace da sharuɗɗan, auna duk yanayin da ke cin karo da juna, zaɓi sulhu mafi dacewa, kuma bayyana dalilin.
l-m-m1-b05-40.material: Yanke maki maki na ɗalibai biyar. Ma'ana shine maki 80, matsakaici shine maki 80, cikakken makin shine maki 95 ko ƙasa da haka, kuma maki dole ne duka ya bambanta. Yi bambanci tsakanin mafi girma da mafi ƙasƙanci maki gwargwadon iko.
l-m-m1-b05-40.s.s1.prompt: Daga cikin zaɓin, wanne ne ke kiyaye yanayin kuma yana da babban bambanci?
l-m-m1-b05-40.s.s1.r.a: Yana kiyaye yanayin, amma bambanci tsakanin mafi girma da mafi ƙasƙanci shine 20, wanda shine ƙarami.
l-m-m1-b05-40.s.s1.r.c: Jimlar ita ce 405, don haka ma'anar ba 80 ba ne, kuma maki 100 ya wuce 95.
l-m-m1-b05-40.s.s1.r.d: Maki 95 ya bayyana sau biyu, don haka maki ba duka ba ne.
l-m-m1-b05-40.s.s1.explain: Zabi na biyu yana da ma'ana da matsakaici na 80, shine 95 ko ƙasa da haka, kuma duk ya bambanta. Bambanci shine 95-60=35, ya fi girma fiye da 20 na farko.
l-m-m1-b05-40.s.s2.model.0: Jimlar ita ce 400, don haka ma'anar ita ce 80, tsakiya kuma 80, kuma duk sun bambanta, don haka yana kiyaye sharuddan, kuma bambancin 35 shine mafi girma.
l-m-m1-b05-40.s.s2.model.1: Na farko yana da ɗan ƙaramin bambanci na 20, na uku yana da jimlar 405, na huɗu kuma yana da 95 sau biyu, don haka sun karya sharuddan. Shi ya sa na biyu ya dace.

l-m-m1-b0s4-14.material: Waxaad plane ku dhigaysaa x-ko’odino −30,−15,25,50. X-axis wuxuu leeyahay 10 unug dhinac kasta asalka. Dooro cabbirka hal unug si dhibcuhu dhammaantood ugu dhacaan layn grid. (15 25)
l-m-m1-b0s4-14.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay cabbirka hal unug ee ku habboon?
l-m-m1-b0s4-14.s.s1.r.a: 50 si loo dhigo waxay u baahan tahay 25 unug, kuma habboona 10.
l-m-m1-b0s4-14.s.s1.r.c: −15 iyo 25 waxay u dhacaan inta u dhaxaysa laymanka grid, si sax ah looma dhigi karo.
l-m-m1-b0s4-14.s.s1.r.d: −15 iyo 25 waxay u dhacaan inta u dhaxaysa laymanka grid, si sax ah looma dhigi karo.
l-m-m1-b0s4-14.s.s1.explain: Haddii unuggu 5 yahay, 50 wuxuu gaaraa 10 unug, −30-na 6 unug; −15 iyo 25 sidoo kale layn bay ku dhacaan. 2 wuxuu dhaafaa baaxadda, 10 iyo 20-na dhibcuhu layn ma saarmaan.
l-m-m1-b0s4-14.s.s2.model.0: Hal unug 5 marka, dhibcaha oo dhan waxay galaan 10 unug oo layn grid ayay saarmaan, waa kan ugu habboon.
